title: Environmental Horticulture and Design
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: PROGRAM EVALUATION (evaluate-program skill). Subject is the PROGRAM (Foothill College x TOP 010900), not a job title. Destination SOCs DERIVED: crosswalk(010900) intersected with SECTORS['agwet'].socs minus ALL_OTHER/PROMOTION/EXPERIENCE_5YR = ['37-3012', '37-1012']. lede: This evaluation assembles labor-market supply and demand evidence for Foothill College's Environmental Horticulture and Design program (TOP 010900): regional demand for the occupations it leads to, its award and enrollment trends alongside other colleges offering the same program in the region, and how its courses align with the work of those occupations.
demand_note: Foothill's Environmental Horticulture and Design program leads to First-Line Supervisors of Landscaping, Lawn Service, and Groundskeeping Workers (SOC 37-1012) and Pesticide Handlers, Sprayers, and Applicators, Vegetation (SOC 37-3012) via the TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), these occupations have roughly 580 openings a year in the Bay Area.
alignment_note: The colleges offering TOP 010900 in the Bay Area. Each supports SOC 37-1012 and SOC 37-3012 through the same TOP–CIP–SOC crosswalk.
award_note: Awards conferred each year by each college's program. An empty cell means DataMart reported no data.
enrollment_note: Enrollment each term in each college's program. An empty cell means DataMart reported no data.

37-3012.description: Mixes and applies pesticides, herbicides, and fungicides to trees, shrubs, lawns, and crops — work that requires specific training and state certification.

37-1012.description: Directs and coordinates landscaping and groundskeeping crews — reviewing contracts to determine service, machine, and workforce requirements.
